In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.
Thou hast bid me gaze upon Thee,
And Thy beauty fills my soul,
For by Thy transforming power,
Thou hast made me whole.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: O, how great Thy loving kindness,
Vaster, broader than the sea!
O, how marvelous Thy goodness,
Lavished all on me!
Yes, I rest in Thee, Belovèd,
Know what wealth of grace is Thine,
Know Thy certainty of promise,
And have made it mine.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Simply trusting Thee, Lord Jesus,
I behold Thee as Thou art,
And Thy love, so pure, so changeless,
Satisfies my heart;
Satisfies its deepest longings,
Meets, supplies its every need,
Compasseth me round with blessings:
Thine is love indeed!

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Ever lift Thy face upon me
As I work and wait for Thee;
Resting 'neath Thy smile, Lord Jesus,
Earth's dark shadows flee.
Brightness of my Father's glory,
Sunshine of my Father's face,
Keep me ever trusting, resting,
Fill me with Thy grace.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, I am resting, resting,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Of Thy loving heart.

title: Jesus I My Cross Have Taken

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, I my cross have taken,
All to leave and follow Thee.
Destitute, despised, forsaken,
Thou from hence my all shall be.
Perish every fond ambition,
All I’ve sought or hoped or known.
Yet how rich is my condition!
God and heaven are still my own.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Let the world despise and leave me,
They have left my Savior, too.
Human hearts and looks deceive me;
Thou art not, like them, untrue.
O while Thou dost smile upon me,
God of wisdom, love, and might,
Foes may hate and friends disown me,
Show Thy face and all is bright.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Man may trouble and distress me,
’Twill but drive me to Thy breast.
Life with trials hard may press me;
Heav'n will bring me sweeter rest.
Oh, ’tis not in grief to harm me
While Thy love is left to me;
Oh, ’twere not in joy to charm me,
Were that joy unmixed with Thee.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Go, then, earthly fame and treasure,
Come disaster, scorn and pain
In Thy service, pain is pleasure,
With Thy favor, loss is gain
I have called Thee Abba Father,
I have stayed my heart on Thee
Storms may howl, and clouds may gather;
All must work for good to me.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: Soul, then know thy full salvation
Rise o’er sin and fear and care
Joy to find in every station,
Something still to do or bear.
Think what Spirit dwells within thee,
Think what Father’s smiles are thine,
Think that Jesus died to win thee,
Child of heaven, canst thou repine.

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: Haste thee on from grace to glory,
Armed by faith, and winged by prayer.
Heaven’s eternal days before thee,
God’s own hand shall guide us there.
Soon shall close thy earthly mission,
Soon shall pass thy pilgrim days,
Hope shall change to glad fruition,
Faith to sight, and prayer to praise.

title: Jesus Keep Me Near the Cross

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, keep me near the cross,
There a precious fountain,
Free to all, a healing stream,
Flows from Calv'ry's mountain.
In the cross, in the cross
Be my glory ever,
Till my raptur'd soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the Bright and Morning Star
Shed His beams around me.
In the cross, in the cross
Be my glory ever,
Till my raptur'd soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Near the cross! O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day
With its shadow o'er me.
In the cross, in the cross
Be my glory ever,
Till my raptur'd soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Near the cross! I'll watch and wait,
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand,
Just beyond the river.
In the cross, in the cross
Be my glory ever,
Till my raptur'd soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the raging waters roll,
While the tempest still is high.
Hide me, O my Savior,
Hide, till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide;
O receive my soul at last.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Other refuge have I none,
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee
Leave, ah! leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring
Cover my defenseless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou, O Christ, art all I want,
All in all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind!
Just and holy is Thy Name,
I am all unrighteousness;
Vile and full of sin I am;
Thou art full of truth and grace.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Plenteous grace with Thee is found,
Grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound;
Make and keep me pure within.
Thou of life the Fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart;
Rise to all eternity.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: I hear the Savior say,
"Thy strength indeed is small;
Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all."
Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, now indeed I find
Thy power and Thine alone,
Can change the leper's spots
And melt the heart of stone.
Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: For nothing good have I
Whereby Thy grace to claim,
I'll wash my garments white
In the blood of Calv'ry's Lamb.
Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: And now complete in Him
My robe His righteousness,
I'll rejoice with all my might,
I am now divinely blest.
Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: And when before the throne
I stand in Him complete,
"Jesus died my soul to save,"
My lips shall still repeat.
Jesus paid it all, all to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: We have heard the joyful sound:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Spread the tidings all around:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Bear the news to every land,
Climb the mountains, cross the waves;
Onward! 'tis our Lord's command;
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Waft it on the rolling tide:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Tell to sinners far and wide:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Sing, you islands of the sea;
Echo back, you ocean caves;
Earth shall keep her jubilee:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Sing above the battle strife:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
By His death and endless life,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Shout it brightly through the gloom,
When the heart for mercy craves;
Sing in triumph o'er the tomb:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Give the winds a mighty voice:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Let the nations now rejoice:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Shout salvation full and free;
Highest hills and deepest caves;
This our song of victory:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Hear the heart of Heaven beating:
Jesus saves, Jesus saves!
Hear His love and mercy pleading:
Jesus saves, Jesus saves!
Hear the host of angels sing,
“Glory to our Risen King!”
And the sounding joy repeating:
Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: He has died our burden bearing.
Jesus saves, Jesus saves!
He now lives our sorrows sharing.
Jesus saves, Jesus saves!
See His love shine in the cross
Christ has paid redemption’s cost!
And the empty tomb’s declaring:
Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Sin’s dark power now is broken.
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
“It is finished!” He has spoken.
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
See the Christ all full of grace,
Melting darkness in His wake.
He’s alive forevermore!
Jesus saves!

verses.label: Bridge
lines: Christ is calling, chains are falling,
Hope is dawning bright and true.
Day is breaking, darkness failing,
God is making all things new.
Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: O to grace, how great a debtor!
Jesus saves, Jesus saves!
All the saints now shout together!
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Turn and know the risen Christ,
The spotless Lamb, our Sacrifice!
And we’ll sing His song forever:
Jesus saves!
Turn and know the risen Christ,
The spotless Lamb, our Sacrifice!
And we’ll sing His song forever:
Jesus saves!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus shall reign where'er the sun
Does its successive journeys run,
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
'Till moons shall wax and wane no more.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Behold the nations great with sin,
Numbers untold that He will win.
From east to west the peoples meet
To bend in worship at His feet.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: To Him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown His head.
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Great God, whose universal sway
The known and unknown worlds obey,
Now give the kingdom to Thy Son
Extend His power, exalt His throne.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: As rain on meadows newly mown,
So shall He send His influence down;
His grace on fainting souls distills,
Like heav'nly dew on thirsty hills.

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: The heathen lands, that lie beneath
The shades of overspreading death,
Revive at His first dawning light
And deserts blossom at the sight.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus said
That if I thirst,
I should come to Him.
No one else can satisfy,
I should come to Him.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus said
If I am weak,
I should come to Him.
No one else can be my strength,
I should come to Him.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For the Lord is good and faithful,
He will keep us day and night!
We can always run to Jesus!
Jesus, strong and kind.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus said
That if I fear,
I should come to Him.
No one else can be my shield,
I should come to Him.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For the Lord is good and faithful,
He will keep us day and night!
We can always run to Jesus!
Jesus, strong and kind.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus said if I am lost
He will come to me.
And He showed me on that cross,
He will come to me.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For the Lord is good and faithful,
He will keep us day and night!
We can always run to Jesus!
Jesus, strong and kind.
For the Lord is good and faithful,
He will keep us day and night!
We can always run to Jesus!
Jesus, strong and kind,
Jesus, strong and kind!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The mystery of the cross
I cannot comprehend
The agonies of Calvary
You, the perfect Holy One,
Crushed Your Son
He drank the bitter cup
Reserved for me.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Your blood has washed away my sin,
Jesus, thank You!
Your Father's wrath completely satisfied,
Jesus, thank You!
Once Your enemy, now seated at Your table,
Jesus, thank You!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: By Your perfect sacrifice,
I've been brought near
Your enemy You made Your friend
Pouring out the riches
Of Your glorious grace
Your mercy and Your kindness
know no end.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Your blood has washed away my sin,
Jesus, thank You!
Your Father's wrath completely satisfied,
Jesus, thank You!
Once Your enemy, now seated at Your table,
Jesus, thank You!

verses.label: Bridge
lines: Lover of my soul, I want to live for You.
Lover of my soul, I want to live for You.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Your blood has washed away my sin,
Jesus, thank You!
Your Father's wrath completely satisfied,
Jesus, thank You!
Once Your enemy, now seated at Your table,
Jesus, thank You!

title: Jesus the Very Thought of Thee

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, the very thought of Thee
With sweetness fills the breast;
But sweeter far Thy face to see,
And in Thy presence rest.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Nor voice can sing, nor heart can frame,
Nor can the memory find
A sweeter sound than Thy blest Name,
O Savior of mankind!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: O Hope of every contrite heart,
O Joy of all the meek,
To those who fall, how kind Thou art!
How good to those who seek!

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: But what to those who find?
Ah, this Nor tongue nor pen can show;
The love of Jesus, what it is,
None but His loved ones know.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: O Jesus, Light of all below,
Thou Fount of living fire,
Surpassing all the joys we know,
And all we can desire.

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: Thee, Jesus, may our voices bless,
Thee may we love alone,
And ever in our lives express
The image of Thine own.

verses.label: Verse 7
lines: O most sweet Jesus, hear the sighs
Which unto Thee we send;
To Thee our inmost spirit cries;
To Thee our souls ascend.

verses.label: Verse 8
lines: Abide with us, and let Thy light Shine,
Lord, on every heart;
Dispel the darkness of our night;
And joy to us impart.

verses.label: Verse 9
lines: Jesus, our love and joy to Thee,
The virgin's holy Son,
All might and praise and glory be,
While endless ages run.

title: Jesus Thy Boundless Love to Me

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, Thy boundless love to me
No thought can reach, no tongue declare;
Oh knit my thankful heart to Thee
And reign without a rival there.
Thine, wholly Thine, alone I am!
Be Thou alone my constant flame.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: O, grant that nothing in my soul
May dwell but Thy pure love alone!
Oh, may Thy love possess me whole,
My Joy, my Treasure, and my Crown!
All coldness from my heart remove;
My every act, word, thought, be love.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: O Love, how gracious is Thy ray!
All fear before Thy presence flies;
Care, anguish, sorrow, melt away
Wherever Thy healing beams arise.
O Jesus, nothing may I see,
Nothing desire or seek, but Thee!

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: In suffering be Thy love my peace,
In weakness be Thy love my power;
And when the storms of life shall cease,
Jesus, in that important hour,
In death as life be Thou my guide,
And save me, who for me hast died.

title: Jesus What a Friend for Sinners

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus! What a Friend for sinners!
Jesus! Lover of my soul;
Friends may fail me, foes assail me,
He, my Savior, makes me whole.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! What a Savior!
Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
He is with me to the end.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus! What a Strength in weakness!
Let me hide myself in Him.
Tempted, tried, and sometimes failing,
He, my Strength, my victory wins.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! What a Savior!
Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
He is with me to the end.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Jesus! What a Help in sorrow!
While the billows over me roll,
Even when my heart is breaking,
He, my Comfort, helps my soul.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! What a Savior!
Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
He is with me to the end.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Jesus! What a Guide and Keeper!
While the tempest still is high,
Storms about me, night overtakes me,
He, my Pilot, hears my cry.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! What a Savior!
Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
He is with me to the end.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: Jesus! I do now adore Him,
More than all in Him I find.
He hath granted me forgiveness,
I am His, and He is mine.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Hallelujah! What a Savior!
Hallelujah! What a Friend!
Saving, helping, keeping, loving,
He is with me to the end.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: If ye abide in Me
And My Words abide in you
If ye abide in Me
And My Words abide in you
If ye abide in Me
And My Words abide in you
Ye shall ask what ye will
And it shall be done unto you.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: If ye abide in Me
And My Words abide in you
If ye abide in Me
And My Words abide in you
If ye abide in Me
And My Words abide in you
Ye shall ask what ye will
And it shall be done unto you.
If ye abide in Me
And My Words abide in you
Ye shall ask what ye will
And it shall be done unto you.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Joy to the world! The Lord is come!
Let earth receive her King;
Let every heart prepare Him room,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven and nature sing,
And heaven, and heaven, and nature sing.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Joy to the earth! The Savior reigns!
Let men their songs employ;
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plains
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat the sounding joy,
Repeat, repeat, the sounding joy.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: No more let sins and sorrows grow,
Nor thorns infest the ground;
He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found,
Far as the curse is found,
Far as, far as, the curse is found.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: He rules the world with truth and grace,
And makes the nations prove
The glories of His righteousness,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders of His love,
And wonders, wonders, of His love.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Joyful, joyful, we adore Thee,
God of glory, Lord of love;
Hearts unfold like flowers before Thee,
Opening to the sun above.
Melt the clouds of sin and sadness;
Drive the dark of doubt away;
Giver of immortal gladness,
Fill us with the light of day!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: All Thy works with joy surround Thee,
Earth and Heaven reflect Thy rays,
Stars and angels sing around Thee,
Center of unbroken praise.
Field and forest, vale and mountain,
Flowery meadow, flashing sea,
Singing bird and flowing fountain
Call us to rejoice in Thee.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Thou art giving and forgiving,
Ever blessing, ever blessed,
Wellspring of the joy of living,
Ocean depth of happy rest!
Thou our Father, Christ our Brother,
All who live in love are Thine;
Teach us how to love each other,
Lift us to the joy divine.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Mortals, join the mighty chorus,
Which the morning stars began;
Father love is reigning o'er us,
Brother love binds man to man.
Ever singing, march we onward,
Victors in the midst of strife,
Joyful music leads us Sunward
In the triumph song of life.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Just as I am, without one plea
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bidd'st me come to Thee,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Just as I am, and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To Thee, whose blood can cleanse each spot,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt,
Fightings and fears within, without,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need, in Thee to find,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: Just as I am, Thou wilt receive,
Wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve;
Because Thy promise I believe,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: Just as I am, Thy love unknown
Has broken ev'ry barrier down;
Now, to be Thine, yea, Thine alone,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The King of Love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never.
I nothing lack if I am His,
And He is mine forever.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Where streams of living water flow,
My ransomed soul He leadeth;
And where the verdant pastures grow,
With food celestial feedeth.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Never failing, Ruler of my heart.
Everlasting, Lover of my soul!
On the mountain high
Or in the valley low,
The King of Love my Shepherd is!
The King of Love my Shepherd is!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Lost and foolish, oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me;
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home, rejoicing, brought me.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: In death's dark vale I fear no ill,
With Thee, dear Lord, beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still,
Thy cross before to guide me.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Never failing, Ruler of my heart!
Everlasting, Lover of my soul!
On the mountain high
Or in the valley low,
The King of Love my Shepherd is!
Never failing, Ruler of my heart.
Everlasting, Lover of my soul!
On the mountain high
Or in the valley low,
The King of Love my Shepherd is!
The King of Love my Shepherd is!

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: So through all the length of days,
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise,
Within Thy house forever.
Within Thy house forever.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: All I once held dear, built my life upon
All this world reveres and wars to own;
All I once thought gain I have counted loss,
Spent and worthless now compared to this.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Knowing You, Jesus, knowing You
There is no greater thing
You're my all, You're the best
You're my joy, my righteousness,
And I love You Lord.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Now my heart's desire is to know You more,
To be found in You and known as Yours,
To possess by faith what I could not earn
All surpassing gift of righteousness

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Knowing You, Jesus, knowing You
There is no greater thing
You're my all, You're the best
You're my joy, my righteousness,
And I love You Lord.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh to know the power of Your risen life,
And to know You in Your sufferings;
To become like You in Your death, my Lord,
So with You to live and never die.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Knowing You, Jesus, knowing You
There is no greater thing
You're my all, You're the best
You're my joy, my righteousness,
And I love You Lord.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Your only Son, no sin to hide,
But you have sent Him from Your side
To walk upon this guilty sod
And to become the Lamb of God

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Oh Lamb of God, sweet Lamb of God,
I love the holy Lamb of God.
O wash me in His precious blood.
My Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Your gift of love, they crucified.
They laughed and scorned Him as He died.
The humble King they named a fraud
And sacrificed the Lamb of God.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Oh Lamb of God, sweet Lamb of God,
I love the holy Lamb of God.
O wash me in His precious blood.
My Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: I was so lost I should have died
But You have brought me to Your side
To be led by Your staff and rod
And to be called a child of God.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Oh Lamb of God, sweet Lamb of God,
I love the holy Lamb of God.
O wash me in His precious blood.
My Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases,
His mercies never come to an end.
They are new ev’ry morning, new ev’ry morning,
Great is Thy faithfulness, O Lord,
Great is Thy faithfulness.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases,
His mercies never come to an end.
They are new ev’ry morning, new ev’ry morning,
Great is Thy faithfulness, O Lord,
Great is Thy faithfulness

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: King of my life I crown Thee now --
Thine shall the glory be;
Lest I forget Thy thorn crowned brow,
Lead me to Calvary.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Lest I forget Gethsemane,
Lest I forget Thine agony,
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Lead me to Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid,
Tenderly mourned and wept;
Angels in robes of light arrayed
Guarded Thee whilst thou slept.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Lest I forget Gethsemane,
Lest I forget Thine agony,
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Lead me to Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Let me like Mary, thru the gloom,
Come with a gift to Thee;
Show to me now the empty tomb --
Lead me to Calvary.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Lest I forget Gethsemane,
Lest I forget Thine agony,
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Lead me to Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: May I be willing, Lord, to bear
Daily my cross for Thee;
Even Thy cup of grief to share --
Thou hast borne all for me.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Lest I forget Gethsemane,
Lest I forget Thine agony,
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Lead me to Calvary.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Lead on, O King eternal,
The day of march has come;
Henceforth in fields of conquest
Thy tents shall be our home.
Through days of preparation
Thy grace has made us strong;
And now, O King eternal,
We lift our battle song.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Lead on, O King eternal,
Till sin's fierce war shall cease,
And holiness shall whisper
The sweet amen of peace.
For not with swords' loud clashing,
Nor roll of stirring drums;
But deeds of love and mercy
The heavenly kingdom comes.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Lead on, O King eternal,
We follow, not with fears,
For gladness breaks like morning
Where'er Thy face appears.
Thy cross is lifted over us,
We journey in its light;
The crown awaits the conquest;
Lead on, O God of might.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: What a fellowship,
What a joy divine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
What a blessedness,
What a peace is mine,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: O how sweet to walk
In this pilgrim way,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
O how bright the path
Grows from day to day,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: What have I to dread,
What have I to fear,
Leaning on the everlasting arms;
I have blessed peace
With my Lord so near,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Leaning, leaning,
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Leaning, leaning,
Leaning on the everlasting arms.

title: Let All Mortal Flesh Keep Silence

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: [Let all the earth keep silence before Him.”
-Habakuk 2:20]

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Let all mortal flesh keep silence,
And with fear and trembling stand;
Ponder nothing earthly minded,
For, with blessing in His hand,
Christ our God to earth descendeth,
Our full homage to demand.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: King of kings, yet born of Mary,
As of old on earth He stood,
Lord of lords, in human vesture,
In the body and the blood.
He will give to all the faithful
His own self for heav'nly food.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Rank on rank the host of heaven
Spreads its vanguard on the way,
As the Light of Light descendeth
From the realms of endless day,
That the pow'rs of hell may vanish
As the darkness clears away.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: At His feet the six-winged seraph,
Cherubim with sleepless eye,
Veil their faces to the Presence,
As with ceaseless voice they cry,
“Alleluia, alleluia,
Alleluia, Lord Most High!”

title: Let Me See Thy Face and Die

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: To Thee, great God of love! I bow,
And prostrate in Thy sight adore;
By faith I see Thee passing now;
I have, but still I ask for more,
A glimpse of love cannot suffice,
My soul for all Thy presence cries.
I cannot see Thy face, and live,
Then let me see Thy face, and die!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Moses Thy backward parts might view,
But not a perfect sight obtain;
The gospel doth Thy fulness show To us,
by the commandment slain;
The dead to sin shall find the grace
The pure in heart shall see Thy face.
I cannot see Thy face, and live, Then
let me see Thy face, and die!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Surrounded by the saints of old,
We now by faith approach
to Thee Shall all with open face behold
In Christ the glorious Deity;
Shall see, and put the Godhead on,
The nature of Thy sinless Son.
I cannot see Thy face, and live,
Then let me see Thy face, and die!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Like a river glorious, is God's perfect peace,
Over all victorious, in its bright increase;
Perfect, yet it floweth, fuller every day,
Perfect, yet it groweth, deeper all the way.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Stayed upon Jehovah,
Hearts are fully blest
Finding, as He promised,
Perfect peace and rest.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Hidden in the hollow of His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow, never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry, not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry touch the spirit there.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Stayed upon Jehovah,
Hearts are fully blest
Finding, as He promised,
Perfect peace and rest.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Every joy or trial falleth from above,
Traced upon our dial by the Sun of Love;
We may trust Him fully all for us to do.
They who trust Him wholly find Him wholly true.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Stayed upon Jehovah,
Hearts are fully blest
Finding, as He promised,
Perfect peace and rest.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: You're the Lion of Judah,
The Lamb who was slain
You ascended to heaven
And evermore will reign
At the end of the age
When the earth You reclaim,
You will gather the nations
Before You.
And the eyes of all men
Will be fixed on the Lamb
Who was crucified!
With wisdom and mercy
And justice You'll reign
At Your Father's side!

verses.label: Chorus
lines: And the angels will cry
Hail the Lamb,
Who was slain for the world!
Rule in power!
And the earth will reply
You shall reign,
As the King of all Kings,
And the Lord of all Lords!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: There's a shield in our hand
And a sword at our side.
There's a fire in our spirits
That cannot be denied.
'Cause the Father has told us
For these You have died
For the nations who gather
Before You
And the ears of all men
Need to hear of the Lamb
Who was crucified!
Who died for our sins
Yet was raised up to reign
At His Father's side!

verses.label: Chorus
lines: And the angels will cry
Hail the Lamb,
Who was slain for the world!
Rule in power!
And the earth will reply
You shall reign,
As the King of all Kings,
And the Lord of all Lords!
And the angels will cry
Hail the Lamb,
Who was slain for the world!
Rule in power!
And the earth will reply
You shall reign,
As the King of all Kings,
And the Lord of all Lords!

title: Little is Much When God Is in It

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: In the harvest field now ripened,
There's a work for all to do.
Hark, the voice of God is calling,
To the harvest calling you.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Little is much when God is in it.
Labor not for wealth or fame.
There's a crown and you can win it,
If you go in Jesus' Name.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: In the mad rush of the broad way,
In the hurry and the strife,
Tell of Jesus’ love and mercy,
Give to them the Word of Life.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Little is much when God is in it.
Labor not for wealth or fame.
There's a crown and you can win it,
If you go in Jesus' Name.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Does the place you're called to labor
Seem so small and little known?
It is great if God is in it,
And He'll not forget His own.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Little is much when God is in it.
Labor not for wealth or fame.
There's a crown and you can win it,
If you go in Jesus' Name.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Are you laid aside from service,
Body worn from toil and care?
You can still be in the battle,
In the sacred place of prayer.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Little is much when God is in it.
Labor not for wealth or fame.
There's a crown and you can win it,
If you go in Jesus' Name.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: When the conflict here is ended
And our race on earth is run,
He will say, if we are faithful,
“Welcome home, My child well done!”

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Little is much when God is in it.
Labor not for wealth or fame.
There's a crown and you can win it,
If you go in Jesus' Name.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: I saw one hanging on a tree
In agony and blood
Who fixed His loving eyes on me
As near His cross I stood
And never till my dying breath
Will I forget that look
It seemed to charge me with His death
Though not a word He spoke

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: My conscience felt and owned the guilt
And plunged me in despair
I saw my sins His blood had spilt
And helped to nail Him there
But with a second look He said
“I freely all forgive
This blood is for your ransom paid
I died that you might live”

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Forever etched upon my mind
Is the look of Him who died
The Lamb I crucified
And now my life will sing the praise
Of pure atoning grace
That looked on me and gladly took my place

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Thus while His death my sin displays
For all the world to view
Such is the mystery of grace
It seals my pardon too
With pleasing grief and mournful joy
My spirit now is filled
That I should such a life destroy
Yet live by Him I killed

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Forever etched upon my mind
Is the look of Him who died
The Lamb I crucified
And now my life will sing the praise
Of pure atoning grace
That looked on me and gladly took my place

title: Lord From Sorrows Deep I call

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, from sorrows deep I call,
When my hope is shaken.
Torn and ruined from the fall,
Hear my desperation!
For so long I’ve pled and prayed!
God, come to my rescue!
Even so the thorn remains.
Still my heart will praise You.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Storms within my troubled soul,
Questions without answers.
On my faith these billows roll,
God, be now my shelter.
Why are you cast down my soul?
Hope in Him who saves you!
When the fires have all grown cold,
Cause this heart to praise You!

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O, my soul, put your hope in God!
My Help, my Rock, I will praise Him!
Sing, oh, sing through the raging storm!
You’re still my God, my Salvation!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Should my life be torn from me,
Every worldly pleasure.
When all I possess is grief,
God, be then my Treasure.
Be my Vision in the night!
Be my Hope and Refuge.
Till my faith is turned to sight,
Lord, my heart will praise You!

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O, my soul, put your hope in God!
My Help, my Rock, I will praise Him!
Sing, oh, sing through the raging storm!
You’re still my God, my Salvation!
O, my soul, put your hope in God!
My Help, my Rock, I will praise Him!
Sing, oh, sing through the raging storm!
You’re still my God, my Salvation!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The depths of Your grace who can measure.
You fully supply all I need.
You restore my weary soul again and again
And lead me in Your righteousness and peace.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: You're with me through every dark valley
There's nothing that I have to fear.
You are there to comfort me again and again,
protecting me, assuring me You're near.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: The Lord is, the Lord is my Shepherd,
The Lord is, the Lord is my Shepherd,
I shall not want.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: You gave Your own life for my ransom
So I could rejoice at Your side.
You have shown your faithfulness again and again,
There's nothing good that You will not provide.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: The Lord is, the Lord is my Shepherd,
The Lord is, the Lord is my Shepherd,
I shall not want.

verses.label: Bridge
lines: I will dwell in Your house
All the days of my life.
I will dwell in Your house
All the days of my life.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: The Lord is, the Lord is my Shepherd,
The Lord is, the Lord is my Shepherd,
I shall not want.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The grace of God has reached for me
And pulled me from the raging sea
And I am safe on this solid ground
The Lord is my salvation

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: I will not fear when darkness falls
His strength will help me scale these walls
I’ll see the dawn of the rising sun
The Lord is my salvation

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Who is like the Lord our God?
Strong to save, faithful in love
My debt is paid and the vict’ry won
The Lord is my salvation

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: My hope is hidden in the Lord
He flow’rs each promise of His Word
When winter fades I know spring will come
The Lord is my salvation

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: In times of waiting, times of need
When I know loss, when I am weak
I know His grace will renew these days
The Lord is my salvation

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Who is like the Lord our God?
Strong to save, faithful in love
My debt is paid and the vict’ry won
The Lord is my salvation

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: And when I reach my final day
He will not leave me in the grave
But I will rise,
He will call me home
The Lord is my salvation

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Who is like the Lord our God?
Strong to save, faithful in love
My debt is paid and the vict’ry won
The Lord is my salvation
Chorus 2
Glory be to God the Father
Glory be to God the Son
Glory be to God the Spirit
The Lord is our salvation
Glory be to God the Father
Glory be to God the Son
Glory be to God the Spirit
The Lord is our salvation
The Lord is our salvation
The Lord is our salvation

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me,
And purge away my sin;
From earthborn passions set me free
And make me pure within.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me,
With many a care oppressed;
Let me Thy loving servant be
And taste Thy promised rest.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me
Amid the battle's strife;
In all my pain and misery
Be Thou my Health and Life.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me
Nor let me go astray;
Through darkness and perplexity
Point Thou the heavenly way.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me
When floods the tempest high;
When on doth rush the enemy,
O Savior, be Thou nigh!

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me
That, when the flood is past,
I may Th'eternal brightness see
And share Thy joy at last.

verses.label: Verse 7
lines: Lord Jesus, think on me
That I may sing above
To Father, Spirit, and to Thee
The strains of praise and love.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord prepare me to be a sanctuary,
Pure and holy, tried and true.
With thanksgiving, I'll be a living
Sanctuary for You.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord prepare me to be a testimony,
Sweet and simple, tried true.
With thanksgiving, I'll be living
Testimony for You.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord prepare me to be a sacrifice,
Pure and holy, tried and true
With thanksgiving, I'll be a living
Sacrifice for You.

title: Lord With Glowing Heart I'd Praise Thee

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord with glowing heart I'd praise Thee,
For the bliss Thy love bestows,
For the pardoning grace that saves me,
And the peace that from it flows:
Help, O God, my weak endeavor;
This dull soul to rapture raise:
Thou must light the flame, or never
Can my love be warmed to praise.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise, my soul, the God that sought me,
Wretched wanderer, far astray;
Found me lost, and kindly brought me
From the paths of death away;
Praise, with love's devoutest feeling,
Him Who saw my guilt-born fear,
And the light of hope revealing,
Bade the blood-stained cross appear.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise my Savior God that drew me
To that cross, new life to give,
Held a blood sealed pardon to me,
Bade me look to Him and live.
Praise the grace whose threats alarmed me,
Roused me from my fatal ease;
Praise the grace whose promise warmed me,
Praise the grace that whispered peace.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, this bosom's ardent feeling
Vainly would my lips express.
Low before Thy footstool kneeling,
Deign Thy suppliant's prayer to bless:
Let Thy grace, my soul's chief treasure,
Love's pure flame within me raise;
And, since words can never measure,
Let my life show forth Thy praise.

title: O Lord, My Rock and My Redeemer

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure of my longing soul!
My God, like You there is no other.
True delight is found in You alone.
Your grace, a well too deep to fathom!
Your love exceeds the heavens' reach!
Your truth, a fount of perfect wisdom,
My highest good and my unending need.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer,
Strong Defender of my weary heart.
My Sword to fight the cruel deceiver,
And my Shield against his hateful darts.
My Song when enemies surround me,
My Hope when tides of sorrow rise,
My Joy when trials are abounding!
Your faithfulness, my Refuge in the night

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer
Gracious Savior of my ruined life.
My guilt and cross laid on Your shoulders,
In my place You suffered bled and died.
You rose! The grave and death are conquered!
You broke my bonds of sin and shame!
You rose! The grave and death are conquered!
You broke my bonds of sin and shame!
O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer
May all my days bring glory to Your Name.
May all my days bring glory to Your Name!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Love Divine, all loves excelling,
Joy of heaven to earth come down;
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling;
All Thy faithful mercies crown!
Jesus, Thou art all compassion,
Pure unbounded love Thou art;
Visit us with Thy salvation;
Enter every trembling heart.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe, O breathe Thy loving Spirit,
Into every troubled breast!
Let us all in Thee inherit;
Let us find the promised rest.
Take away our bent to sinning;
Alpha and Omega be;
End of faith, as its Beginning,
Set our hearts at liberty.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Come, Almighty to deliver,
Let us all Thy life receive;
Suddenly return and never,
Never more Thy temples leave.
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above,
Pray and praise Thee without ceasing,
Glory in Thy perfect love.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Finish, then, Thy new creation;
Pure and spotless let us be.
Let us see Thy great salvation
Perfectly restored in Thee;
Changed from glory into glory,
Till in heaven we take our place,
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love, and praise.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The love of God is greater far
Than tongue or pen can ever tell.
It goes beyond the highest star
And reaches to the lowest hell.
The guilty soul, bowed down with care,
God gave His Son to win;
His erring child He reconciled
And pardoned from his sin.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O love of God, how rich and pure!
How measureless and strong!
It shall forevermore endure
The saints’ and angels’ song.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: When hoary time shall pass away,
And earthly thrones and kingdoms fall;
When men who here refuse to bow,
On rocks and hills and mountains call;
God’s love, so sure, shall still endure,
All measureless and strong;
Redeeming grace to Adam’s race
The saints’ and angels’ song.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O love of God, how rich and pure!
How measureless and strong!
It shall forevermore endure
The saints’ and angels’ song.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Could we with ink the ocean fill,
And were the skies of parchment made;
Were every stalk on earth a quill,
And every man a scribe by trade;
To write the love of God above
Would drain the ocean dry;
Nor could the scroll contain the whole,
Though stretched from sky to sky.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O love of God, how rich and pure!
How measureless and strong!
It shall forevermore endure
The saints’ and angels’ song.

title: O Love That Will Not Let Me Go

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: O Love that will not let me go,
I rest my weary soul in Thee;
I give Thee back the life I owe,
That in Thine ocean depths its flow
May richer, fuller be.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: O Light that followest all my way,
I yield my flickering torch to Thee;
My heart restores its borrowed ray,
That in Thy sunshine's blaze its day
May brighter, fairer be.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: O Joy that seekest me through pain,
I cannot close my heart to Thee;
I trace the rainbow through the rain,
And feel the promise is not vain,
That morn shall tearless be.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: O Cross that liftest up my head,
I dare not ask to fly from Thee;
I lay in dust life's glory dead,
And from the ground
There blossoms red
Life that shall endless be.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Majesty, worship His Majesty.
Unto Jesus be all glory, honor and praise!
Majesty, Kingdom Authority,
Flow from His throne, unto His own
His anthem raise!
So exalt, lift up on high the Name of Jesus!
Magnify, come glorify, Christ Jesus the King.
Majesty, worship His Majesty;
Jesus who died, now glorified, King of all kings!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Majesty, worship His Majesty.
Unto Jesus be all glory, honor and praise
Majesty, Kingdom Authority
Flow from His throne, unto His own
His anthem raise.
So exalt, lift up on high the Name of Jesus
Magnify, come glorify, Christ Jesus the King.
Majesty, worship His Majesty;
Jesus who died, now glorified, King of all kings!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Man of Sorrows, what a Name,
For the Son of God, Who came
Ruined sinners to reclaim.
Hallelujah! What a Savior!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
In my place condemned He stood;
Sealed my pardon with His blood.
Hallelujah! What a Savior!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Guilty, vile, and helpless we;
Spotless Lamb of God was He;
"Full atonement!" can it be?
Hallelujah! What a Savior!

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Lifted up was He to die;
"It is finished!" was His cry;
Now in Heav'n exalted high.
Hallelujah! What a Savior!

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: When He comes, our glorious King,
All His ransomed home to bring,
Then anew His song we'll sing:
Hallelujah! What a Savior!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Marvelous grace of our loving Lord,
Grace that exceeds our sin and our guilt!
Yonder on Calvary's mount outpoured,
There where the blood of the Lamb was spilt.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that will pardon and cleanse within;
Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that is greater than all our sin.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Sin and despair, like the sea waves cold,
Threaten the soul with infinite loss;
Grace that is greater, yes, grace untold,
Points to the Refuge, the Mighty Cross.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that will pardon and cleanse within;
Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that is greater than all our sin.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Dark is the stain that we cannot hide.
What can avail to wash it away?
Look! There is flowing a Crimson Tide,
Brighter than snow you may be today.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that will pardon and cleanse within;
Grace, grace, God's grace,
Grace that is greater than all our sin.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The Master has come
And He calls us to follow
The track of His footprints
He leaves on our way;
Far over the mountain
And through the deep hollow,
The path leads us on
To the eternal day:
The Master has called us,
The children who fear Him,
Who march ‘neath Christ’s banner
His own little flock;
We love Him and seek Him,
We long to be near Him,
And rest in the strength
Of this unyielding Rock.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: The Master has called us
To walk in the valleys,
The shadow of death
And the evil so near;
But God who does lead us
To feed in green meadows,
We hear His rejoicing
That brings us to cheer.
The Master has called us,
We run hard to hold Him,
And cling to our Shepherd,
Who stands as our King;
Defends us and helps us,
Our hearts now adoring,
We’ll pass thru this valley
And shout as we sing.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: The Master has called us
To live for His glory,
To tell of His mercy
And wonderful grace;
Salvation, revelation,
Redeemed is our story,
He seeks us and finds us
And quickens our pace.
The Master has called us
And love is His banner,
The sheep of His pasture
The chosen in Him;
Our bondage is broken,
Our enemies fallen,
We’ll march on victorious
Thru God we shall win.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: The Master has called us
The road may be dreary;
And dangers and demons
May form their attack;
Press onward, look upward
Through much tribulation,
We follow the Savior
And cannot turn back.
The Master has called us
A people most favored,
To ever move forward
And never retreat;
So work on dear brethren
Till we rest from labor,
When we’re in the presence
Of Jesus so sweet.

title: May Great Grace Fall Upon Us

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord we read in Thy Word,
How Thy people once were stirred
When Thy Spirit came and shook their meeting place
How our hearts long to know
Of that Grace that stirred them so
Hear our prayer, O Lord, as now we seek Thy face

verses.label: Chorus
lines: May great grace fall upon us, Lord we pray
May great grace fall upon us, Lord, today
May Thy Word be preached with power,
Fill our need of Thee this hour,
And may great grace fall upon us, Lord we pray

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord, today, as long ago,
We Thy people need Thee so
For Thy power alone can light the Gospel flame
Lord, be pleased to bless this place
With the Spirit of Thy Grace
Send Thy Gospel forth and glorify Thy Name

verses.label: Chorus
lines: May great grace fall upon us, Lord we pray
May great grace fall upon us, Lord, today
May Thy Word be preached with power,
Fill our need of Thee this hour,
And may great grace fall upon us, Lord we pray

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Meekness and majesty, manhood and deity
In perfect harmony, the Man who is God.
Lord of eternity dwells in humanity,
Kneels in humility and washes our feet.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Father's pure radiance, perfect in innocence
Yet learns obedience to death on a cross.
Suffering to give us life,
Conquering through sacrifice,
And as they crucify prays Father forgive!

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O, what a mystery! Meekness and majesty!
Bow down and worship, for this is your God!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Wisdom unsearchable, God the invisible,
Love indestructible in frailty appears.
Lord of infinity stooping so tenderly,
Lifts our humanity to the heights of His throne.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O, what a mystery! Meekness and majesty!
Bow down and worship, for this is your God!
O, what a mystery! Meekness and majesty!
Bow down and worship, for this is your God!
Bow down and worship, for this is your God!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: I will kneel in the dust
At the foot of the cross,
Where mercy paid for me.
Where the wrath I deserved,
It is gone, it has passed.
Your blood has hidden me.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Mercy, mercy
As endless as the sea.
I'll sing Your hallelujah
For all eternity.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: We will lift up the cup
And the bread we will break,
Remembering Your love.
We were fallen from grace,
But You took on our shame
And nailed it to the cross.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Mercy, mercy
As endless as the sea.
I'll sing Your hallelujah
For all eternity.

verses.label: Bridge
lines: May I never lose the wonder,
Oh, the wonder of Your mercy.
May I sing Your hallelujah.
Hallelujah, Amen.

Oh, the wonder of Your mercy.

Hallelujah, Amen.

I'll sing Your hallelujah

title: A Mighty Fortress is Our God

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: A mighty fortress is our God
A bulwark never failing;
Our helper He, amid the flood
Of mortal ills prevailing:
For still our ancient foe
Doth seek to work us woe;
His craft and power are great,
And, armed with cruel hate,
On earth is not his equal.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Did we in our own strength confide,
Our striving would be losing;
Were not the right Man on our side,
The Man of God's own choosing:
Dost ask who that may be?
Christ Jesus, it is He;
Lord Sabaoth, His Name,
From age to age the same,
And He must win the battle.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: And though this world, with devils filled,
Should threaten to undo us,
We will not fear, for God hath willed
His truth to triumph through us:
The prince of darkness grim,
We tremble not for him;
His rage we can endure,
For lo, his doom is sure,
One little word shall fell him.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: That word above all earthly powers,
No thanks to them, abideth;
The Spirit and the gifts are ours
Through Him who with us sideth:
Let goods and kindred go,
This mortal life also;
The body they may kill:
God's truth abideth still,
His kingdom is forever.

title: More Love to Thee, O Christ

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: More love to Thee, O Christ,
More love to Thee!
Hear Thou the prayer I make
On bended knee;
This is my earnest plea:
More love, O Christ to Thee,
More love to Thee!
More love to Thee!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Once earthly joy I craved,
Sought peace and rest;
Now Thee alone I seek,
Give what is best;
This all my prayer shall be:
More love, O Christ to Thee,
More love to Thee!
More love to Thee!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Let sorrow do it's work,
Send grief and pain;
Sweet are Thy messengers,
Sweet their refrain;
When they can sing with me:
More love, O Christ to Thee,
More love to Thee!
More love to Thee!

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Then shall my latest breath,
Whisper Thy praise:
This be the parting cry,
My heart shall raise;
This still its prayer shall be:
More love, O Christ to Thee,
More love to Thee!
More love to Thee!

title: My Faith Has Found a Resting Place
composer: Words: Eliza E. Hewitt [Lidie H. Edmunds]

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: My faith has found a resting place,
Not in device or creed;
I trust the ever living One,
His wounds for me shall plead.
I need no other argument,
I need no other plea,
It is enough that Jesus died,
And that He died for me.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Enough for me that Jesus saves,
This ends my fear and doubt;
A sinful soul I come to Him,
He'll never cast me out.
I need no other argument,
I need no other plea,
It is enough that Jesus died,
And that He died for me.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: My heart is leaning on the Word,
The living Word of God,
Salvation by my Savior's Name,
Salvation through His blood.
I need no other argument,
I need no other plea,
It is enough that Jesus died,
And that He died for me.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: My great Physician heals the sick,
The lost He came to save;
For me His precious blood He shed,
For me His life He gave.
I need no other argument,
I need no other plea,
It is enough that Jesus died,
And that He died for me.

title: My Faith Looks Up to Thee

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: My faith looks up to Thee,
Thou Lamb of Calvary, Savior divine!
Now hear me while I pray, take all my guilt away,
O let me from this day be wholly Thine!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: May Thy rich grace impart
Strength to my fainting heart, my zeal inspire!
As Thou hast died for me, O may my love to Thee,
Pure warm, and changeless be, a living fire!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: While life's dark maze I tread,
And griefs around me spread, be Thou my Guide;
Bid darkness turn to day, wipe sorrow's tears away,
Nor let me ever stray from Thee aside.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: When ends life's transient dream,
When death's cold sullen stream over me roll;
Blest Savior, then in love, fear and distrust remove;
O bear me safe above, a ransomed soul!

title: My Hope is Built on Nothing Less

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: My hope is built on nothing less
Than Jesus' blood and righteousness.
I dare not trust the sweetest frame,
But wholly lean on Jesus' Name.
On Christ the solid Rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: When darkness veils His lovely face,
I rest on His unchanging grace.
In every high and stormy gale,
My anchor holds within the veil.
On Christ the solid Rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: His oath, His covenant, His blood,
Support me in the whelming flood.
When all around my soul gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.
On Christ the solid Rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: When He shall come with trumpet sound,
Oh may I then in Him be found.
Dressed in His righteousness alone,
Faultless to stand before the throne.
On Christ the solid Rock I stand,
All other ground is sinking sand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: My Jesus, I love Thee, I know Thou art mine;
For Thee all the follies of sin I resign.
My gracious Redeemer, my Savior art Thou;
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: I love Thee because Thou hast first loved me,
And purchased my pardon on Calvary's tree.
I love Thee for wearing the thorns on Thy brow;
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: I'll love Thee in life, I will love Thee in death;
And praise Thee as long as Thou lendest me breath;
And say, when the deathdew lies cold on my brow:
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: In mansions of glory and endless delight,
I'll ever adore Thee in Heaven so bright;
I'll sing with the glittering crown on my brow:
If ever I loved Thee, my Jesus, 'tis now.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: This life is an altar
Where I want to offer
My soul, and my mind, and strength
Cleansed by Your mercy to live a life worthy
Of the One Who called my name

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Jesus, be glorified
Jesus, be magnified
Let me be a pleasing sacrifice
Jesus, be glorified
Jesus, be magnified
Here on the altar
My life is an offering

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: How could I not love You?
You authored my rescue
Raised me up from death to life
Your Spirit is in me, revealing Your glory
Oh what joy as I give my life

Jesus, be magnified

Jesus, be magnified
Here on the altar
My life is an offering

title: My Lord, I Did Not Choose You

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: My Lord, I did not choose You,
For that could never be;
My heart would still refuse You,
Had You not chosen me.
You took the sin that stained me,
You cleansed me, made me new;
Of old You have ordained me,
That I should live in You.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For Christ my All, my Great Reward
Adorns my life forevermore!
Nothing can change now, who I am,
I'm in Christ, the Hope of man!
I'm in Christ, the Hope of man.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Unless Your grace had called me
And taught my op'ning mind,
The world would have enthralled me,
To heav'nly glories blind.
My heart knows none above You;
for Your rich grace I thirst;
I know that if I love You,
You must have loved me first.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For Christ my All, my Great Reward
Adorns my life forevermore!
Nothing can change now, who I am,
I'm in Christ, the Hope of man!
I'm in Christ, the Hope of man.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Unless Your Spirit claimed me;
I’d still be bound in sin
Yet Christ alone has saved me
And now I’m found in Him.
And when I stand in glory
And faith gives way to sight
Your joy will crown the chosen
In everlasting light!

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For Christ my All, my Great Reward
Adorns my life forevermore!
Nothing can change now, who I am,
I'm in Christ, the Hope of man!
I'm in Christ, the Hope of man.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Whom have I in Heaven but You?
There is none besides You I desire.
Though my heart and
Flesh become weak
You’re my strength,
The portion of my life.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For I know that my Redeemer lives!
All control is within His hands.
Though my heart may fail,
And my flesh pass away,
With these eyes I will
Behold the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Lord create a clean heart in me,
And let only what’s from You remain.
If need be, when in trials
I am grieved
Let my faith, Lord,
Be proved genuine.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For I know that my Redeemer lives!
All control is within His hands.
Though my heart may fail,
And my flesh pass away,
With these eyes I will
Behold the Lord.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: When trials seem too difficult for me,
Let Your grace be my sufficiency!
Of You I’ve heard by
The hearing of the ear
But Your face is what
I long to see.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: For I know that my Redeemer lives!
All control is within His hands.
Though my heart may fail,
And my flesh pass away,
With these eyes I will
Behold the Lord.
For I know that my Redeemer lives!
All control is within His hands.
Though my heart may fail,
And my flesh pass away,
With these eyes I will
Behold the Lord

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: My song is love unknown–
My Savior’s love to me;
Love to the loveless shown,
That they might lovely be.
Oh, who am I, that for my sake
My Lord should take frail flesh and die?

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: He came from His blest throne
Salvation to bestow;
But men made strange, and none
The longed for Christ would know.
But oh, my Friend, my Friend indeed,
Who at my need His life did spend!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Sometimes they strew His way,
And His sweet praises sing;
Resounding all the day
Hosannas to their King.
Then “Crucify!” is all their breath,
And for His death they thirst and cry.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Why, what hath my Lord done?
What makes this rage and spite?
He made the lame to run;
He gave the blind their sight.
Sweet injuries! Yet they at these
Themselves displease,
And 'gainst Him rise.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: They rise, and needs will have
My dear Lord made away.
A murderer they save;
The Prince of Life they slay.
Yet cheerful He to suff'ring goes,
That He His foes from thence might free.

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: In life, no house, no home
My Lord on earth might have;
In death, no friendly tomb
But what a stranger gave.
What may I say? Heav'n was His home;
But mine the tomb wherein He lay.

verses.label: Verse 7
lines: Here might I stay and sing–
No story so divine!
Never was love, dear King,
Never was grief like Thine.
This is my Friend, in whose sweet praise
I all my days could gladly spend.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Arise, my soul, arise!
Shake off your guilty fears.
The bleeding sacrifice
On my behalf appears.
Before the throne my surety stands,
Before the throne my surety stands.
My name is written on His hands.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: He ever lives above
For me to intercede.
His all redeeming love,
His precious blood to plead.
His blood atoned for every race,
His blood atoned for every race.
And sprinkles now the Throne of Grace.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O my soul, arise!
Behold the risen Christ,
Your great High Priest,
Your spotless sacrifice!
O my soul, arise!
God owns you as His child!
Shake off your guilty fears,
My soul, arise!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Five bleeding wounds He bears,
Received on Calvary.
They pour effectual prayers,
They strongly plead for me.
"Forgive him, O forgive," they cry.
"Forgive him, O forgive," they cry.
"Don't let that ransomed sinner die."

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: The Father hears Him pray,
His dear anointed One;
He cannot turn away,
The presence of His Son;
His Spirit answers to the blood,
His Spirit answers to the blood,
And tells me I am born of God.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O my soul, arise!
Behold the risen Christ,
Your great High Priest,
Your spotless sacrifice!
O my soul, arise!
God owns you as His child!
Shake off your guilty fears,
My soul, arise!

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: My God is reconciled,
His pard'ning voice I hear.
He owns me as His child;
I can no longer fear.
With confidence I now draw nigh.
With confidence I now draw nigh,
And "Father, Abba, Father!" cry.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: O my soul, arise!
Behold the risen Christ,
Your great High Priest,
Your spotless sacrifice!
O my soul, arise!
God owns you as His child!
Shake off your guilty fears,
My soul, arise!

title: My Worth is Not in What I Own
composer: By Keith & Kristyn Getty, and Graham Kendrick

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: My worth is not in what I own,
Not in the strength of flesh and bone,
But in the costly wounds of love
At the cross.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: My worth is not in skill or name,
In win or lose, in pride or shame,
But in the blood of Christ that flowed
At the cross.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: I rejoice in my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure,
Wellspring of my soul!
I will trust in Him, no other.
My soul is satisfied in Him alone.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: As summer flowers we fade and die,
Fame, youth and beauty hurry by,
But life eternal calls to us
At the cross.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: I will not boast in wealth or might,
Or human wisdom's fleeting light,
But I will boast in knowing Christ
At the cross.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: I rejoice in my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure,
Wellspring of my soul!
I will trust in Him, no other.
My soul is satisfied in Him alone.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: Two wonders here that I confess,
My worth and my unworthiness.
My value fixed - my ransom paid,
At the cross.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: I rejoice in my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure,
Wellspring of my soul
I will trust in Him, no other.
My soul is satisfied in Him alone.
I rejoice in my Redeemer
Greatest Treasure,
Wellspring of my soul!
I will trust in Him, no other.
My soul is satisfied in Him alone.

lines: The Lord is good,
A stronghold in the day of trouble;
And He knoweth them that trust in Him.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: May we run this race,
May we keep the faith,
May our eyes be fixed
On Jesus
That we'll not lose heart
In our struggle with sin
And through suffering
Know endurance.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: May we arm ourselves
With the mind of Christ,
To rejoice in trials
And be not surprised.
May our hearts be so
Consumed by You
That we never
Cease to praise!

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: May our company be
The saints You've called
May we all stand
Firm in One Spirit,
That the gospel's truth
May resound on earth
That all living things
May hear it

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: May the fruits of faith
Mark the path we trod
Through the life of Christ
To the glory of God.
May our hearts be so
Consumed by You
That we never
Cease to praise!

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: May the words we share
Be Your grace and peace
May our tongues speak
Your proclamations,
That the many parts
Of the Body of Christ
Be affirmed in their
Right relation.

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: As we long and wait
For our Groom to come
May we learn to love
And spur each other on.
May our hearts be so
Consumed by You
That we never
Cease to praise!

verses.label: Verse 7
lines: When that day arrives,
And the race is won,
When our griefs give way
To deliverance.
We will fully know
As we're fully known,
All our groans will end
As new songs begin.

verses.label: Verse 8
lines: And a multitude from
Every tribe and tongue,
Wearing robes of white
Will stand before
Your throne
And our hearts will be so
Consumed by You
That we'll never
Cease to praise!
May our hearts be so
Consumed by You
That we never
Cease to praise!

title: Not What My Hands Have Done

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Not what my hands have done
Can save my guilty soul;
Not what my toiling flesh has borne
Can make my spirit whole
Not what I feel or do
Can give me peace with God;
Not all my prayers and sighs and tears
Can bear my awful load.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Thy work alone, O Christ,
Can ease this weight of sin;
Thy blood alone, O Lamb of God
Can give me peace within.
Thy love to me, O God,
Not mine, O Lord, to Thee,
Can rid me of this dark unrest,
And set my spirit free.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Thy grace alone, O God,
To me can pardon speak;
Thy power alone, O Son of God,
Can this sore bondage break.
No other work, save Thine,
No other blood will do;
No strength, save that which is divine,
Can bear me safely through

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: I bless the Christ of God;
I rest on love divine;
And with unfaltering lip and heart,
I call this Savior mine.
His cross dispels each doubt;
I bury in His tomb
Each thought of unbelief and fear
Each lingering shade of gloom.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: I praise the God of grace;
I trust His truth and might;
He calls me His, I call Him mine,
My God, my joy, my light.
'Tis He who saveth me,
And freely pardon gives;
I love because He loveth me,
I live because He lives.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
Naught of this world's delusive dream;
I have renounced all sinful pleasure;
Jesus is mine, there's nothing between.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor:
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Nothing between, like worldly pleasure;
Habits of life, though harmless they seem;
Must not my heart from Him ever sever;
He is my All, there's nothing between.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor:
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Nothing between, like pride or station;
Self or friends shall not intervene;
Though it may cost me much tribulation,
I am resolved, there's nothing between.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor:
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Nothing between, e'en many hard trials,
Though the whole world against me convene;
Watching with prayer and much self denial,
I'll triumph at last, there's nothing between.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Nothing between my soul and the Savior,
So that His blessed face may be seen;
Nothing preventing the least of His favor:
Keep the way clear! Let nothing between.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: What can wash away my sin?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Oh! Precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: For my cleansing, this I see,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
For my pardon this my plea,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Oh! Precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Nothing can for sin atone,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus;
Naught of good that I have done,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: Oh! Precious is the flow
That makes me white as snow;

title: Our God Our Help in Ages Past

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Our God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Our shelter from the stormy blast,
And our eternal home.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Under the shadow of Thy throne
Thy saints have dwelt secure;
Sufficient is Thine arm alone,
And our defense is sure.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Before the hills in order stood,
Or earth received her frame,
From everlasting Thou art God,
To endless years the same.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: A thousand ages in Thy sight
Are like an evening gone;
Short as the watch that ends the night
Before the rising sun.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: Time, like an ever rolling stream,
Bears all its sons away;
They fly, forgotten, as a dream
Dies at the opening day.

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: Our God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Be Thou our guard while troubles last,
And our eternal home.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Verse 1:
Eternal God, unchanging,
Mysterious, yet made known.
Your boundless love, unfailing
In grace and mercy shown.
Bright seraphim in ceaseless flight
Around Your glorious throne
They raise their voices day and night
In praise to You alone.
Chorus:
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Verse 2:
Lord, we are weak and frail
Helpless in the storm.
Surround us with Your angels
Hold us in Your arms.
Our cold and ruthless enemy
His pleasure is our harm.
Rise up, oh Lord, and he will flee
Before our sovereign God!
Chorus:
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Verse 3:
Let every creature in the sea
And every flying bird
Let every mountain, every field
And valley of the earth,
Let all the moons and all the stars
And all the universe
Sing praises to the living God
Who rules them by His Word!
Chorus:
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!
Hallelujah, glory be to our great God!

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Our Sovereign God by His own word
Sustains this world and reigns as Lord.
No angel, demon, sinful man can change
His course, restrain His hand.
O sovereign God, we praise Your pow'r;
Your wisdom, goodness we adore!
We bow our hearts before Your throne;
Help us, O Lord, to trust You more,
Help us, O Lord, to trust You more.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: When the fullness of the time had come,
God sent His own Beloved Son.
To keep God's law, live in our place,
To bear our sin, guilt and disgrace.
Dead in our sin, estranged from God,
We fled as rebels from His love.
In sovereign grace He made us sons,
And saved us from the wrath to come,
And saved us from the wrath to come.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Before our birth He planned our days,
Laid out our course, ordained our ways.
The moments of our lives He weaves
So all the glory He receives.
To those He loved before all time,
To all He called, and grace renewed,
He cannot lie; His word is true,
He makes all things to work for good,
He makes all things to work for good.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: He has written history's final page
His Son's return will end this age.
The Lamb will come in glorious might,
Take back His world and end it's night.
How deep the wisdom of our God,
Unknown, unfathomed are His ways.
None counsels Him or knows His mind.
We bow before Him all our days,
We bow before Him all our days
O Sovereign God, we praise Your pow'r;
Your wisdom, goodness we adore!
We bow our hearts before Your throne;
Help us, O Lord, to trust You more,
Help us, O Lord, to trust You more.

I thank my God

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: O, to see the dawn of the darkest day
Christ on the road to Calvary
Tried by sinful men, torn and beaten, then
Nailed to a cross of wood.
This the power of the cross:
Christ became sin for us.
Took the blame, bore the wrath;
We stand forgiven at the cross.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: O, to see the pain written on Your face,
Bearing the awesome weight of sin.
Every bitter thought, every evil deed
Crowning the bloodstained brow.
This the power of the cross:
Christ became sin for us.
Took the blame, bore the wrath;
We stand forgiven at the cross.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Now the daylight flees; now the ground beneath
Quakes as the Maker bows His head.
Curtain torn in two, dead are raised to life.
"Finished!" the victory cry.
This the power of the cross:
Christ became sin for us.
Took the blame, bore the wrath;
We stand forgiven at the cross.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: O, to see my name written in the wounds,
For through Your suffering I am free.
Death is crushed to death, life is mine to live,
Won through Your selfless love!
This the power of the cross:
Son of God slain for us.
What a love! What a cost!
We stand forgiven at the cross.

title: Praise the Savior, You Who Know Him

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Words: Thomas Kelly 1806
Music: Traditional German Melody

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise the Savior, you who know Him!
Who can tell how much we owe Him?
Gladly let us render to Him
All we are and have.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Jesus is the name that charms us;
He for conflict fits and arms us;
Nothing moves and nothing harms us
While we trust in Him.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Trust in Him, you saints, forever;
He is faithful, changing never;
Neither force nor guile can sever
Those He loves from Him.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Keep us, Lord, O keep us cleaving
To Thyself and still believing,
Till the hour of our receiving
Promised joys with Thee.

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: Then we shall be where we would be,
Then we shall be what we should be;
Things that are not now, nor could be,
Soon shall be our own.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise to the Lord,
The Almighty, the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him,
For He is thy Health and Salvation!
All ye who hear, now to His temple draw near;
Praise Him in glad adoration.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Praise to the Lord,
Who over all things so wondrously reigneth,
Shelters thee under His wings,
Yea, so gently sustaineth!
Hast thou not seen how thy desires ever have been
Granted in what He ordaineth?

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Praise to the Lord,
Who doth prosper thy work and defend thee;
Surely His goodness and mercy
Shall daily attend thee.
Ponder anew what the Almighty will do,
If with His love He befriend thee.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Praise to the Lord,
O let all that is in me adore Him!
All that hath life and breath,
Come now with praises before Him.
Let the Amen sound from His people again,
Gladly for aye we adore Him.

And I will pay my vows in full
Where men hold Him in fear.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: O God, please listen to my prayer;
Do not ignore my plea.
My anxious thoughts make me distraught;
O hear and answer me.
I’m troubled by the voice of foes,
By their malicious stare;
For they bring suf-fer-ing to me
Their hatred I must bear.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Within me anguish grips my heart;
Death’s terrors have come near.
I tremble and am terrified;
I’m overwhelmed by fear.
“O that I, like a dove, had wings!
Then I would fly away
And be at rest; I’d flee from here
And in the desert stay.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: “Then would I to my hiding-place
For refuge take my flight,
Far from the raging of the storm
And from the tempest’s might.”
Distressed, I cry— He hears my voice.
He ransoms me unharmed
From battle waged by many foes,
Who are against me armed.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: My God, enthroned for evermore,
Will hear and will repay
Those men who have no fear of God
And never change their way.
O cast your burden on the LORD,
And he will care for you;
He’ll never let the righteous fall,
But bring him safely through.

From my trouble, refuge bring

verses.label: Verse 2

title: Psalm 62 (My Soul Will Wait)
composer: Music and words by Keaton Bunting and Bob Kauflin

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: When the enemy surrounds,
And my heart grows faint within,
When the darkness overwhelms,
And my fears are pressing in,
I will trust in You, O Lord,
In the silence I will wait,
I will stand upon Your Word.

verses.label: Chorus

And my Salvation,
My Steadfast Hope
That won’t be shaken,
My soul will wait,
My soul will wait for You!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: You’re my Stronghold and my Shield,
In the midst of every threat.
Though the wicked never yield,
They will vanish like a breath.
Yes, I know the outcome’s sure,
Satan’s evil plans will fail
In Your power I’m secure.

verses.label: Chorus
lines: You’re my Solid Rock
And my Salvation,
My Steadfast Hope
That won’t be shaken,
My soul will wait,
My soul will wait for You!

verses.label: Verse 3

This is mercy unreserved.
Through Your sacrifice so great,
I have peace that’s undeserved
For the battle has been won!
And I fear no shame or loss
Now the sting of death is gone.

verses.label: Chorus

My Refuge and my Sure Foundation
My soul will wait,
My soul will wait for You!
